'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[2025 Sumy offensive]]
***One person is killed and 13 others are injured, including two seriously, in a [[Russia]]n [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] on a [[minibus]] in [[Mykolaivka, Sumy Raion, Sumy Oblast|Mykolaivka]], [[Sumy Raion]], [[Sumy Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/62983 (''Kyiv Post'')]
**Two people are killed, including an elderly woman, and another is injured in a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] drone strike on an apartment building in Russian-controlled [[Donetsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/two-killed-one-injured-in-ukrainian-drone-attack-on-russian-controlled-donetsk/vi-AA1PhTnw?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=c9fb607a54ee4674b244e5171a71f551&ei=56 (MSN)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Siege of El Fasher]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] say that they have captured [[El Fasher]], the last stronghold of the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] in [[North Darfur]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sudans-rsf-says-it-captured-al-fashir-army-headquarters-2025-10-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Three people are killed in two [[Israel]]i [[airstrikes]] in [[An-Naqoura]] and [[Baalbek]], [[Lebanon]]. Separately, an Israeli [[Drone warfare|drone]] drops a grenade near [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon|UNIFIL]] forces in [[Kfar Kila, Lebanon|Kfar Kila]], without casualties. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/26/israeli-strikes-kill-three-in-lebanon-before-army-targets-un-patrol (Al Jazeera)]
*A man plants an explosive near [[propane]] [[gas cylinder]]s at a [[Filling station|gas station]] in [[Georgetown, Guyana|Georgetown]], [[Guyana]], killing a child and wounding four other people. The attacks is described as a terrorist incident, while the perpetrators are unknown. [https://apnews.com/article/guyana-gas-station-attack-953752fc189a5baeb5caa11e779fe2d8 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Patriarch]] [[Patriarch Daniel of Romania|Daniel]] consecrates the newly-constructed [[National Cathedral of Romania|National Cathedral]] in [[Bucharest]], [[Romania]], as the country's largest cathedral with the capacity for 5,000 worshippers and the [[Patriarch of All Romania|patriarchal]] seat of the [[Romanian Orthodox Church]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/romania-opens-worlds-biggest-orthodox-church/a-74504366 (DW)] [https://www.romania-insider.com/national-cathedral-consecration-event-october-2025 (Romania Insider)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Fourteen people are killed when a fire engulfs dwellings in [[Bukavu]], [[South Kivu]], Democratic Republic of the Congo. [https://www.africanews.com/2025/10/27/drc-deadly-fire-ravages-bukavu-neighborhood-claiming-14-lives/ (Africanews)]
*Thirteen people are killed and five others are injured when a bus crashes in [[Kano State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://punchng.com/gombe-gov-mourns-13-victims-of-kano-road-crash/ (''The Punch'')]
*At least 13 people are killed and 29 others are injured when a bus collides with a car and plunges off of a bridge into a stream in [[Puerto Iguazú]], [[Misiones]], [[Argentina]]. [https://news.az/news/nine-killed-in-argentina-bus-crash (News.Az)] [https://english.news.cn/20251027/d3dceb6c017b417ba134f756c79fbb5f/c.html (Xinhua)]
*In separate incidents, an [[MH-60R Seahawk]] helicopter and an [[F/A-18F Super Hornet]] fighter jet of the [[United States Navy]], both operating off of the {{USS|Nimitz}} [[aircraft carrier]], crash in the [[South China Sea]]. All crew of both craft are rescued. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/10/26/politics/navy-aircraft-crash-south-china-sea (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Cameroonian presidential election]]
**[[Cameroon]]ian opposition [[President of Cameroon|president]]ial candidate [[Issa Tchiroma]] says that police have detained more than 30 politicians and activists linked to his campaign or who endorsed his candidacy against incumbent [[Paul Biya]] during last week's election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/cameroon-detains-opposition-figures-ahead-presidential-results-2025-10-26/ (Reuters)]
**Four protestors are killed and several policemen are injured during clashes in [[Douala]], as pro-opposition protestors rejects Biya's re-election. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/26/two-killed-in-cameroon-protests-ahead-of-election-results-opposition-says (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2025 Louvre robbery]]
**Two suspects are arrested in connection to the robbery at the [[Louvre Museum]] in [[Paris]], [[France]], last week. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/26/two-suspects-from-louvre-jewellery-heist-arrested-by-french-police-reports (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency]]
**[[2025 PKK–Turkey peace process]]
***The [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] announces that it is withdrawing its fighters from [[Turkey]] and moving them to [[Iraq]] as part of ongoing peace talks with the [[Turkish government]]. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-iraq-pkk-kurdish-22e611009304bd8a822bc74ad5007162 (AP)]
*[[2025 Argentine legislative election]]
**[[Argentines]] vote in the [[midterm election|midterms]] to elect a half of the [[Argentine Chamber of Deputies|Chamber of Deputies]] and a third of the [[Argentine Senate|Senate]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/10/25/world/americas/argentina-elections-milei.html (''The New York Times'')]
**The ruling [[La Libertad Avanza]] party of [[President of Argentina|President]] [[Javier Milei]] wins the election with over 40% of the votes. [https://apnews.com/article/argentina-midterm-election-javier-milei-66d7c03825a7a0f56ce5808ff3ac1df4 (AP)]
*[[2026 Colombian presidential election]]
**The [[Historic Pact]] party nominates [[Senate of Colombia|Senator]] [[Iván Cepeda]] as its candidate for [[President of Colombia|president]] in next year's election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombias-left-picks-ivan-cepeda-2026-presidential-candidate-2025-10-26/ (Reuters)]
